sourceText:
Beef Noodle Parmesan Bake
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups uncooked spaghetti noodles, broken into 2" pieces
2 tablespoons butter
1 sm. onion, chopped
1 pound ground beef
4 tablespoons butter
3 tablespoons flour
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon chopped garlic
1/8 teaspoon pepper
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese
2 cups milk
1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce

Preparation

1 Boil spaghetti until done. Put in 9 x 13 inch pan. Melt 2 tablespoons butter, saute onions and brown the beef. Drain fat off. Mix beef with noodles. 2 Melt 4 tablespoons butter in 1 quart saucepan. Add flour, salt, garlic, pepper and Parmesan cheese. Mix milk and Worcestershire sauce together. Gradually add milk mixture to saucepan, stirring between additions. 3 Simmer white sauce until thickened and then add to beef and noodles, mix thoroughly. Top with parsley and sliced tomatoes. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Serves 6.
